title: Otori Emu — At A Stage Full Of Smiles〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: At A Stage Full Of Smiles（4★）

rows.Line: Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ahhh, that was so much fun!!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And everyone else watching had such big smiles on their faces!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, this musical definitely lived up to the hype!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A comedy about an evening in the world of witches.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In order to draw the audience into the story, they created an intricate world and reflected that in the set and costumes. To put it in one word, it was fantastic...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
The songs also left a big impression.
Each one had memorable lyrics and a catchy melody.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Their dance routines were really fun too!
When all the witches appeared together during that one scene, I almost stood up to dance with them♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I know what you mean! That scene included an almost overwhelming number of dances, but they were such wonderful expressions of the witches' feelings that my heart began to soar!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Mine too!
I think it went something like this...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tap-tappity-tap-tap♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, you memorized it after just watching it once?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe! I paid really close attention because I wanted to try dancing it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Nicely done, Emu!
Next, what follows should be...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup yup! A mishap occurs during their meeting, so their dancing gets all panicked!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That dance really made things feel hectic. I loved how they were sorta all over the place.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. I'm impressed by your memory as well, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
It was a very striking scene!
That being said, I can't say that I remember every individual step.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I think you're supposed to raise your knee high while stepping and then...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Didn't they do side steps or something?
Also, some moves that hip hop dancers do.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, and...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Hehe. I invited them to come see this musical with me on really short notice...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (But talking about shows with them is just so much fun!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Oh, that reminds me!
The dance that the heroine did...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, are we just gonna keep talking here...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... Yes, the sun is already starting to set.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Time does fly when you're having fun.
Why don't we resume this conversation at a later date?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Right. It's getting dark, so I guess that means it's time for us to say bye bye to each other...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu...? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Not yet...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I don't wanna go home yet!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I wanna keep talking with you guys!
Please! Just for a little bit longer!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Could we...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, I think we have our hands tied now...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In that case, I'll let my family know that I'll be staying out a bit longer.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
...!
You mean it?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. To be honest, I also wanna keep talking about it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Me too. If we're going to talk, we should do so while it's still fresh in our minds.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
There should be a diner just nearby.
Why don't we talk there?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We want to talk too, so don't thank us.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, let's head over to that diner♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hey, Emu, wait!
You need to let your family know as well!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I will☆
